condition_name: Tinea Infected with secondary bacterial Infection
description: A dermatophyte skin infection complicated by secondary bacterial infection.

appearance.general: Fungal lesions may develop increased pain, crusting, discharge, or spreading inflammation.

warning_signs: Increasing pain, spreading redness, pus, fever, or systemic illness can indicate secondary bacterial infection and requires medical assessment.
